cards.mood: The track opens with a vulnerable, intimate atmosphere that gradually builds into a resilient and anthemic declaration during the choruses.
cards.vocal: A single Male vocalist delivers the performance with a smooth, velvety tenor timbre that carries a distinct warmth and slight raspiness in the upper register.
